cohort: A total of 315 women with pelvic floor dysfunction (PFD) who visited a pelvic floor rehabilitation centre in Beijing, China.
finding: Self-efficacy had a direct effect on PFMT adherence, while social support and knowledge of PFD had an indirect effect on PFMT adherence through self-efficacy.
cross-section timing: Measurements taken between October 2022 and August 2023, when patients were treated or reviewed.
